E2 = value added at sub-national accounts, `implemented` per doctrine/METRIC_REGISTRY.yaml, licensed as a composition by D-13 (2 October 2026). E1 (ARERA penalties per LV user) is DECLARED ABSENT: it is published for italy alone. Intra-coverage 0.45 is declared on every record as _E_coverage and rolled up into composite_coverage_intra, because composite_coverage is COMPONENT-level per Convention #21 and would otherwise credit E's full 0.10 silently. I7,I8,I9 are DECLARED ABSENT. I7, I8 and I9 are stored on NO record in the estate. Every present metric is `implemented` in doctrine/METRIC_REGISTRY.yaml and entered in doctrine/METRIC_PROVENANCE.yaml (P15-M-1). The sweep (doctrine/EVIDENCE_provenance_sweep_20261005.json) records none of them nor their raw inputs as FABRICATED on this fleet, while components.I IS fabricated here -- so this replaces a name hash with measurements. Intra-coverage is declared on every record as _I_coverage and rolled into composite_coverage_intra, because composite_coverage is COMPONENT-level per Convention #21 and would otherwise credit I's full 0.25 silently. The 0.45 floor is the flag officer's D-16 ruling of 5 October 2026.

component_swaps.declaration: derived per INTRA_WEIGHTS['C'] = {C1 0.40, C2 0.30, C3 0.15, C4 0.15} over the three metrics this fleet carries, intra-coverage 0.85, renormalised over the present set. This is italy's own measured set and the fullest C in the estate outside italy. C1 = UNPLANNED CML (customer minutes lost), C2 = UNPLANNED CI / 100 (CI is customers interrupted PER 100 CUSTOMERS, so the per-customer rate is CI/100), C4 = PLANNED CML, all per licence area for 2024/25, from Ofgem's RIIO-2 Electricity Distribution annual report 2024-2025 SUPPLEMENTARY DATAFILE, sheet 'Ch2 outputs - reliability'. The report itself PLOTS these per area in Figures 1 and 2 and prints no table; a chart is not a source, and this datafile carries the numbers behind the charts, from the regulator, one methodology for all fourteen areas. Frozen as data/c_metrics/uk.csv by scripts/ssi_fetch_c_metrics_uk_ofgem.py with the workbook's sha256 and twenty-one header anchors recorded; written into `metrics` by scripts/ssi_persist_metrics_C_uk.py. THE SPLIT IS GATED ON A CHECK THE FILE ITSELF SUPPLIES: planned + unplanned must reproduce the totals block, parsed sixty rows away, and it does on all 28 area-quantity pairs within 1.4e-14. An earlier reading of this sheet declared C4 ABSENT on the strength of one column label, 'CI target (Planned and unplanned)', which names the target block and not the sheet; the split is at row 74 and reading it took C from 0.70 to 0.85. ONE EVENT TREATMENT, measured and not defaulted: Ofgem publishes a single figure per area per quantity per year, and the sheet's only severe-weather object is the Regulation 7 Severe Weather Conditions Adjustment, which adjusts the incentive payment in pounds and does not restate CI or CML. So the uk carries no basis flag where the us carries one. The previous year IS carried, in the manifest's c_basis_uk unit table, and it is stable: Spearman 0.8769 on CI and 0.9253 on CML over the fourteen areas. THE JOIN IS A GEOGRAPHY, NOT A NAME: the uk fleet carries NO operator field -- operator_canonical, operator_role and resolution_layer are empty on all 59,744 records -- so the licence area is assigned by point-in-polygon on each record's own lat/lon against the frozen GB DNO licence-area layer (NESO via Northern Powergrid open data, 14 features, sha256 in a sidecar), by scripts/ssi_assign_uk_dno_licence_area.py: 59,130 of 59,744 assigned, 98.97%, all 14 areas reached, 613 Northern Ireland records DECLARED ABSENT because the layer is GB and NIE Networks reports separately, and 1 record outside every polygon. Fourteen Ofgem licence codes are aliased to the layer's longnames, each leg with its reason in the sidecar -- E111's rule -- including SP ENW, which is Electricity North West mislabelled in the regulator's own file. GRANULARITY CROSSING (Convention #22): the licence-area value is assigned UNIFORMLY to the substations within it, with no allocator, because the regulator publishes at licence area. NORMALISATION: Method B, soft_clip imported from pipeline.scoring.engine, percentiles over UNITS -- departing from the us on the us script's OWN stated condition, that record weighting discards no published fact. With fourteen areas it does: record-weighting pins 4, 3 and 4 areas on C1, C2 and C4 (0.3076, 0.2242 and 0.2790 of the joined records) and makes UKPN (London) at 10.45 unplanned CML minutes and WPD (South Wales) at 22.61 -- a 2.16x difference between two published regulated figures -- the same number, 0.0. Unit-weighting pins the two extremes only, which is irreducible on fourteen units. The shared collapse guard PASSES IDENTICALLY under both, pinned 0.0478 and retention 1.000, because it measures the composite; that the guard cannot see a metric-level collapse is on the ruling sheet. --weighting records reproduces the us treatment on demand. NO REPRESENTATIVENESS FLOOR applies, unlike the us: Ofgem's CI and CML are the licensee's whole-area regulated performance figures with reward and penalty in pounds beside them in the same block, not an aggregation of voluntary respondents, so there is no coverage ratio to publish and _C_customer_coverage is ABSENT on this fleet rather than set to 1.0, which would be a claim. C3 is DECLARED ABSENT: it is a fraction of the maximum set by ARERA TIQE article 32 and Ofgem sets no such ceiling. Not substituted and not zero, under the flag officer's D-6 ruling of 5 October 2026. A DECLARED DEFINITIONAL DIFFERENCE: italy's C2 column is named for long AND short interruptions; this datafile states no duration threshold for CI anywhere in it, and a threshold the source does not state is not asserted. It does not enter the arithmetic -- Method B normalises within each fleet, never across fleets -- and it is on the ruling sheet rather than smoothed over. Intra-coverage 0.85 is declared on every record as _C_coverage and rolled into composite_coverage_intra, because composite_coverage is COMPONENT-level per Convention #21. It is the highest declared C coverage outside italy and clears the 0.45 floor ruled under D-16.

component_swaps.correction: AMPLIFIED 9 October 2026, after this declaration landed. NOTHING ABOVE IS WITHDRAWN. Two cautious sentences are resolved against the governing document and one material axis is added, under E210's rule that a complete set of true statements is not a complete declaration. (1) THE THRESHOLD IS ESTABLISHED AND IT IS THREE MINUTES. The sentence above saying this datafile states no duration threshold, and that a threshold the source does not state is not asserted, was CORRECT ABOUT THE DATAFILE and remains the right caution about it. The RIGs that govern the datafile state it: RIIO-ED2 Regulatory Instructions and Guidance, Annex F (Interruptions) v1.1, para 2.7 classes an incident as one lasting three minutes or longer, and para 4.7 defines a short interruption as restoration in under three minutes. E200's distinction - a data dictionary is not a determination - resolving in the estate's favour. This also supplies the primary source for new zealand's declaration, which contrasts its own one-minute threshold against a uk, ireland, switzerland and chile family using three. (2) OFGEM'S CI AND CML INCLUDE TRANSMISSION-CAUSED INTERRUPTIONS, so this fleet's C is ALL-CAUSES on the cause axis. Annex F para 4.3 gives CI_t as the sum of five terms - CIA unplanned incidents on the distribution system, CIB pre-arranged incidents on it, CIC incidents on the systems of NGET or the transmission companies in Scotland, CID incidents on distributed generators' systems, CIE any other connected systems - and para 4.5 repeats it for CML. That is italy's basis and the us's. IT IS NOT NEW ZEALAND'S, whose C1 is Class C alone, 'unplanned interruptions on the network', and therefore excludes its Transpower, generation and other-party classes by construction: on that fleet the excluded part is 22.83 per cent of unplanned minutes and worth up to 0.4160 of a normalised metric (E210). A reader comparing this fleet's C1 with new zealand's is comparing an all-causes quantity with a network-only one. THE UK TAXONOMY IS THE NEAR-EXACT ANALOGUE OF NEW ZEALAND'S: CIA maps to Class C, CIB to Class B, CIC to Classes A and D, CID to Classes E and F, CIE to Classes G, H and I - the uk collapsing planned and unplanned within the non-distribution categories where new zealand splits them. And para 4.4 and 4.6 require EACH TERM TO BE SEPARATELY IDENTIFIED, so a network-only uk C comparable to new zealand's is CONSTRUCTIBLE IN PRINCIPLE: the regulator collects the split. Para 2.8 carves out one narrow upstream class - load shedding in compliance with statutory or licence obligations following upstream transmission or generation incidents is not an incident at all. (3) TWO OPEN QUESTIONS, NEITHER ANSWERABLE FROM THIS REPOSITORY, both needing a re-read of the source: uk/_cache/ does not exist and XLSM_SHA256 is pinned to the acquisition release. FIRST, WHICH OF THE FIVE TERMS DOES THE 'UNPLANNED' COLUMN SPAN? The sheet's split is TWO-way and the cause taxonomy is FIVE-way, so the two are orthogonal; if the totals block is CI_t then UNPLANNED must span CIA plus CIC plus CID plus CIE. THAT IS AN INFERENCE FROM THE ADDITIVITY THIS FETCHER ALREADY GATES ON - planned plus unplanned reproducing the totals block to 1.4e-14 - AND IT IS NOT ASSERTED. SECOND, ARE THESE FIGURES EXCEPTIONAL-EVENT ADJUSTED? Ofgem's RIIO-2 Electricity Distribution Annual Report 2024 to 2025 states that adjustments for Severe Weather Exceptional Events have been applied based on DNO submissions, and defines neither the planned nor the unplanned category anywhere in it. If the Performance columns read here are SWEE-adjusted, this fleet sits on the OPPOSITE side of the exceptional-event axis from the us, whose declared basis is expressly All Events WITH Major Event Days, and from italy's 'tutte le cause'. Until one of those is read at the source, the uk's position on the exceptional-event axis is UNESTABLISHED AND IS NOT ASSERTED EITHER WAY. No value, coverage figure, score, band or _cprov position is touched by this amplification, and the declared intra-coverage of 0.85 is unchanged. E212 - RIIO-ED2 RIGs Annex F (Interruptions) v1.1, paras 2.7, 2.8, 4.3, 4.4, 4.5, 4.6, 4.7, read at ofgem.gov.uk.

geography_writes.source: Northern Powergrid open data, dataset all_dno_boundaries, mirroring NESO 'GIS Boundaries for GB DNO Licence Areas'
geography_writes.method: point-in-polygon on the record's own lat/lon against the frozen GB DNO licence-area layer, shapely covers(), STRtree-indexed. No crosswalk and no name match: the uk fleet carries no operator field.
geography_writes.note: a geography only. No metric, component, score or band moves.

edge_exposure.distance_method: distance from each record to the boundary of ITS OWN licence area, in a per-area local metric frame (x = lon * 111320 * cos(area centroid latitude), y = lat * 110540). NOT geodesic; a raw EPSG:4326 distance would overstate east-west offsets by 1/cos(lat), about 1.7x at 54 N. Immaterial to a 100 m / 500 m / 1 km screen and not to be quoted to the metre.
edge_exposure.layer_positional_accuracy: NOT STATED BY THE LAYER OR ITS SIDECAR
edge_exposure.why_that_matters: whether the records nearest an edge are actually misassigned depends on the layer's positional accuracy and on each record's coordinate precision. The frozen sidecar records bytes, coverage, features, frozen_utc, licence_areas, producer, sha256, source and url - and no scale, generalisation, accuracy or resolution. So these counts are a measured population with an unmeasurable risk, and the figure that would close it belongs to NESO.
edge_exposure.not_a_defect: ZERO of the assigned records lie outside the polygon they were assigned to. Nothing is reassigned and nothing should be: preferring a neighbour on a distance heuristic would create a defect where measurement found none.
edge_exposure.not_a_withdrawal: No component, metric, score, band or _cprov is affected. Measuring how much of a record is known is not a reason to publish less of it.

NO REPRESENTATIVENESS FLOOR applies: Ofgem's figures are the licensee's whole-area regulated performance with money attached, not an aggregation of voluntary respondents, so _C_customer_coverage is ABSENT rather than 1.0. _provenance_legend.order: C V I E S T
_provenance_legend.a: absent — the component key is not on the record
_provenance_legend.L: linked — the record carries a per-component source for this component. AMENDED 2 October 2026: the source now OUTRANKS the value. Before, a declared source was overruled whenever the value happened to equal a generator's output or to be zero, which it did on 121 positions across eleven jurisdictions.
_provenance_legend.u: UNLINKED — reproduces neither generator AND carries no source. NOT the same as derived.
_provenance_legend._cprov_coincidence: present only where a position is L AND the value would also have reproduced a generator, or is zero. The component letters, in C V I E S T order. A seventh marker symbol was considered and refused: every consumer of _cprov would have had to learn it, and the fact is rarer than one record in five thousand.

_composite_coverage_legend: Convention #21. The summed COMPONENT_WEIGHTS of the components whose _cprov slot reads L — that is, the components carrying a RECORDED SOURCE. It is not a count of components derived from a measurement; a source string is a provenance claim and not a measurement claim, and the two were conflated in this field's original definition. A completeness claim, NOT a truth claim: a record may read high and still be substantially a hash of its own name. Presenting coverage as a quality score is banned. The separation of presence, provenance and derivation is before the flag officer in doctrine/AMENDMENT_20261001_convention_21_the_three_coverages.md
_province_repair: `province` was set to this record's own joined region code - _region_nuts3 for a NUTS fleet, _region_itl3 for the United Kingdom - by scripts/ssi_repair_province_from_region_join.py. It previously held a token of the substation's synthetic name, which named a region the record was not in on 197 of greece's 548 and 720 of the uk's 2,542.
